column1: # Anchor detection failure rates over the 7,436-plasmid MPF_T set (PF03135-admitted).
# CURATED. This REPLACES the binary core/peripheral label.
# WHY NO BINARY LABEL: VirB5 at 7.5% falls between the tightest group (4.1-4.9%)
# and the next (9.0-20.9%). Any cutoff placed between them is arbitrary, and a
# binary column would discard the failure rate -- which is the actual measurement.
# `group` below is a DESCRIPTIVE annotation of where a rate falls, not a threshold
# any downstream code may branch on. Code that needs a cut must declare its own
# and say so; do not read `group` as a decision.
# failure_ga        Pfam model at its own threshold (anchor_set.tsv)
# failure_final     after an ADMISSIBLE disjunction, else identical to failure_ga
# disjunction       adopted / REJECTED (+ the control that rejected it) / n/a
# A rejected disjunction's union is NOT recorded here in the failure column,
# deliberately: VirB2 would read 5.2% and VirB3 5.0%, and those numbers must not
# become quotable. They are in data/anchors/peripheral_anchor_swap.tsv with their
# rejection reasons attached.
